race.comment: STRIKING ALIBI (12) creates plenty of interest on debut for Waller, formerly based in WA trained by Luke Fernie. Won well on debut at Ascot before thrown in the deep end seven days later when safely held in the Karrakatta. Has looked very smart in both trials this time in and they book Lloyd. Expected to take some holding out. BUBBLES UP (9) showed good ability in her maiden preparation and is expected to lead from the inside. Rates well and should take some pegging back. LULL (3) won well at Canterbury last start and only looks to have to repeat that level of performance to be right around  the mark again. SCENIC POINT (4) steps out on debut for the Joe Pride stable and they book Nash which sends off a few alarm bells. Has to be included. UNCERTAIN GLORY (13) is a nice filly, just worried she'll be out of play early from the draw.
